mood.text: Arsenal are flying right now. Good time to be [his name].

this_week.text: North London Derby this weekend. The biggest game of the season so far for [his name]. He's been thinking about this all week.
this_week.talking_point: Are you nervous about the derby?

post_match.text: Arsenal just beat Spurs 3-1 in the derby. [his name] is on cloud nine right now. Let him have this moment, he's earned it.
post_match.talking_point: That was massive, right?! You must be buzzing.

basics.fun_fact: Arsenal once went an entire 49-game Premier League run without losing. They literally called themselves 'The Invincibles' and honestly, fair enough. If [his name] ever mentions it, just nod, it's their proudest flex.
basics.talking_point: Did you know Arsenal once went 49 games without losing? That's insane.

manager.name: Mikel Arteta
manager.summary: Been in charge since 2019. Used to be Pep Guardiola's assistant at Man City (that's basically like training under the best manager in the world). He's turned Arsenal from a bit of a mess into genuine title contenders. [his name] probably rates him highly.
manager.talking_point: Do you think Arteta's the right manager to win the league?

players.name: Bukayo Saka
players.one_liner: Arsenal's golden boy. He's 24 and already their most important player. If [his name] could only keep one player, it'd be him.

players.name: William Saliba
players.one_liner: The reason Arsenal don't concede many goals. He's French, he's calm under pressure, and he's basically a brick wall in human form.

players.name: Declan Rice
players.one_liner: Cost £105 million. Does all the boring stuff in midfield that wins games. Think of him as the reliable colleague who keeps the whole office running.

ones_to_know.talking_point: Which player does he talk about the most? Saka?

rivalry.text: Tottenham Hotspur, the North London Derby. They're from the same part of London and have been at each other's throats for over a century. Think of it like two siblings who fundamentally cannot let the other one have nice things. If Spurs lose, [his name] is happy. If Spurs win something (rare), he's annoyed for days. It's deeply personal.
rivalry.talking_point: How long have Arsenal and Spurs actually hated each other?

form.form_summary: They've won 4 of their last 5, so [his name] is probably in a good mood about football right now. The one loss stung though, they don't like to talk about it.
form.talking_point: Four wins out of five, that's pretty good right?

season.summary: This season is all about the title race. Arsenal finished 2nd last year (again) and [his name] is desperate for them to finally win it. They've been close two years running now, so the pressure is massive. Every single game feels like a final. If he seems tense on weekends, this is probably why.
season.talking_point: Do you actually think this is the year they win it?

next_fixture.preview: North London Derby at the Emirates. Arsenal haven't lost to Spurs at home in over three years.
next_fixture.talking_point: Derby day! How are you feeling about it?
